Wunjo — Rune Meaning

← All rune meanings
ᚹ
joy harmony things working out belonging

Upright meaning

Wunjo is one of the most welcome runes you can draw — it's basically saying that joy and harmony are headed your way, or already here if you slow down enough to notice.

This isn't the giddy, short-lived kind of happiness. It's the deeper, quieter kind — the sense that things are actually working out, that you're in the right place, that the pieces are coming together. A relationship might feel warmer, a long effort might finally show results, or you might just feel genuinely content for a change.

Don't brush past it. Let yourself enjoy this. You've earned it.

Reversed meaning

Reversed Wunjo is a signal that something's getting in the way of your happiness. You might have all the right ingredients for a good life but still feel like something's not right — and that gap is worth paying attention to.

Sometimes it's unresolved stuff — grief, resentment, stress — that hasn't been dealt with. Sometimes you're chasing a version of happiness that isn't really yours.

Ask yourself what's actually standing between you and feeling genuinely okay. The answer might be uncomfortable, but it's the starting point for real change.
